notes_for_editor: Two independent descriptions (register and firelookout.com) agree on the 1934 cab and the 1951 sale and move; the place-name link is weaker. The association gives the standing cab as 'Reynaud'; the register and the relocation list say only 'a ranch 4 miles up the Twisp River'. The story now says no source ties the Reynaud name to the ranch, so whether they are the same place is unconfirmed. A WebSearch summary of a 2021 Methow Valley News item (https://methowvalleynews.com/2021/07/14/valley-life-twisp-20/) reports a 1933 purchase, a 1951 public-auction sale to a named Reynaud family member, and a 2003 move to a Reynaud Loop Road overlook. I could not quote it: the cached copy (data/raw/web/0478968c70039e53367ece9e7e875ff6d28d43f5.bin) is gzip-compressed and fetch_text does not decompress it, so the text came back as binary. If fetch_text is fixed to gunzip responses, that article should be re-read; it may correct the location and add the 2003 move. The 1934 date is the register's; the 1933 purchase is unverified. Methownet's 'End of Lookouts?' page returned 404 and was not used. No photos added.
